reviewed_document: Final offering circular dated 2025-03-25, SGX file 65399
rank_guarantee_collateral: Direct senior unsecured obligation; no guarantor identified for this tranche
verified_covenants_and_events: Negative pledge applies to issuer and Principal Subsidiaries for External Indebtedness secured on Restricted Property. Secured debt can be allowed up to aggregate 15% of Net Tangible Assets without equal-and-ratable security; enumerated carve-outs. review_outcome: Direct clause verified; credit support limited

rank_guarantee_collateral: Senior unsecured parent obligation, structurally subordinated to liabilities at Controlled Entities; effectively subordinated to secured obligations to collateral value
verified_covenants_and_events: Negative pledge covers issuer and Principal Controlled Entities over defined Relevant Indebtedness; merger/substantially-entire asset sale restrictions; no general restriction on ordinary additional debt or dividends. Event of Default includes cross-default/acceleration only if aggregate affected debt is at least the greater of USD100m or 2.5% of Total Equity; judgment threshold uses same greater-of test and 90-day duration. 101% Triggering Event Offer. limitations_or_gaps: This is not a general change-of-control put. “Substantially all” interpretation is uncertain. Offering document expressly warns cash may be insufficient and other debt may bar repurchase. There is no collateral or broad leverage/dividend covenant.
review_outcome: Direct clause verified; 101% is contingent payment obligation, not funded protection

reviewed_document: Final offering memorandum dated 2022-01-05 (SGX-listed; full text cross-checked on India INX)
rank_guarantee_collateral: Senior unsecured and unsubordinated issuer obligation; pari passu with issuer's other unsecured unsubordinated debt; effectively subordinated to secured issuer debt and subsidiary liabilities; no subsidiary guarantee found
verified_covenants_and_events: Negative pledge applies only to Security Interests securing defined non-INR/offshore-traded Securities; if issuer grants such security it must grant equal security/guarantee or obtain noteholder approval. Merger/substantially-all-assets transfer permitted if successor assumes obligations and no continuing default. EoD: interest unpaid after 10 days; other covenant breach after 45 days notice from holders of >=25%; cross-default/nonpayment on issuer borrowed money aggregate >=USD250m, with acceleration rescission window 21 days; certain attachment/receiver events have 120-day cure. 25% holders may accelerate. Optional make-whole redemption; 2052 spread 25bp, plus tax redemption. No general change-of-control put identified in the final OM; no maintenance financial covenant.
limitations_or_gaps: Negative pledge does not cover all secured borrowings: it is restricted to defined securities and the noteholder is not collateralized. Subsidiaries are not restricted from incurring debt, creating structural subordination. A downgrade is not an EoD. The notes are under a fiscal agency agreement; fiscal agent is not trustee.
review_outcome: Final issue terms reviewed; covenant scope verified
